phase_prompt.label: The Silent Witnesses
phase_prompt.summary: The Kings stand at the edge of the habitable zone, watching the thermal waters shift from healing streams to instruments of judgment. They are paralyzed by the unfolding system purge.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Close-up portrait, hyper-realistic. The face of an old, powerful ruler, skin texture highly detailed, pores visible. He is looking off-camera with an expression of dawning horror. The lighting is high-contrast, 'Rembrandt' style, highlighting the fear in his eyes. In the blurred background, a massive column of steam and digital distortion rises from a rift. Reflections of blue system errors visible in the moisture on his face. Cinematic drama, slow shutter feel, depth of field focus on eyes.
